title: Naturally Spicy Uruguayan Skirt Steak Skewers
description: A spicy and flavorful Uruguayan dish featuring skirt steak, tempered chocolate, and a raw friendly glassy jelly, perfect for showing off at any dinner party. The combination of spicy and sweet flavors will leave your guests impressed.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
Thread the skirt steak pieces onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together pineapple juice, red pepper flakes, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the steak.
Grill the skewers for 5 minutes per side, or until the steak reaches 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the steak is cooking, melt the tempered chocolate in a double boiler.
Once the steak is done, brush the melted chocolate onto the steak.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
Drizzle any remaining pineapple juice mixture over the top of the skewers.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
